subject: Status of our shipment FRA to MEX, 1902 kg
body:
Hello,

could you please tell me the current status of our shipment: Hofmann Textilwerk KG, FRA to MEX, 1902 kg, ready on 2026-11-27? Where is it now?

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The sender asks for the current location and status of a shipment.
